name: PDF
description: Reads any PDF, even scanned ones, and fills in forms for you. Text is recognized on this computer.
author: Hob

starters.title: Fill in a PDF form
starters.prompt: /fill-pdf Fill in this form for me.

prompt: For PDFs, use read_pdf (it reads scanned pages too) and fill_pdf to fill in forms. Don't use run_python for PDFs and don't turn pages into images. To fill a form: read it once, ask only for answers to its listed blanks that you don't have, never sign for the user, then call fill_pdf right away.
